title: The Comet Claim War
logline: When a massive water-ice comet enters the sector, an old ice-harvester dynasty and an automated utility giant battle for the rights to thaw it.

roles.description: A weathered octogenarian who has harpooned comets by hand for fifty years and refuses to see the old lanes automated.
Regional head of the automated utility giant; regards manual ice-rigging as an unsafe, obsolete anachronism.
The guild of independent cometary ice haulers whose livelihoods depend on unautomated harvesting.
A mega-utility corporation deploying autonomous thermal drillers to monopolize sector water.
The jagged, glittering nucleus of the passing rogue comet, venting plumes of pressurized steam.
A neutral frontier fueling depot where ice tenders and corporate drones converge to refuel.
A heavy privateer frigate deployed by the conglomerate to enforce its exclusive navigation charter.

public_situation: A newly charted rogue comet carrying millions of tons of pure water-ice enters {system}, sparking armed claim disputes between legacy haulers and corporate drillers.
private_truth: The conglomerate deliberately faked orbital hazard calculations to declare the comet an imminent navigation threat and justify seizing sole salvage rights.

beats.public_change: The conglomerate posts an exclusive safety perimeter around the approaching comet nucleus, barring all guild tenders.

missions.reason: The veteran captain needs a cargo of hand-harvested cometary ice delivered to the frontier waystation to prove the guild's manual claim is already active.
missions.private_fact: The veteran mortgaged his family's signature harvester ship to pay for the pilot's contract, wagering everything on this claim.

beats.public_change: Corporate gunboats jump into the neighbouring gate sector, ambushing guild tugs attempting to establish telemetry beacons.

missions.reason: The captain pays the pilot to destroy the lead corporate gunboat guarding the gate corridor so the guild's deep-space tenders can jump through safely.
missions.private_fact: The gunboat's transponder logs prove it was contracted through an offshore security subsidiary to skirt sector warfare bans.

beats.public_change: The conglomerate initiates automated thermal drilling on the comet core, threatening to shatter the nucleus into hazardous fragments.

missions.reason: The captain needs the pilot to scan the automated drilling array on the comet nucleus and retrieve the geological stress telemetry.
missions.private_fact: The telemetry proves the corporate thermal drills are causing structural fissures that will splinter the comet within days.

beats.public_change: Faced with telemetry proof of catastrophic fragmentation risk, the corporate director requests an emergency bilateral hearing.

missions.reason: The director asks the pilot to courier formal settlement parameters to the waystation to negotiate a joint operational easement.
missions.private_fact: The director's private brief authorizes offering the old captain a lavish lifetime pension if the guild surrenders all claim rights.

beats.public_change: Both fleets anchor around the border waystation as delegates assemble to sign the final cometary harvesting accord.

missions.reason: The old captain needs the pilot to deliver the finalized treaty charter to the arbitrator's rostrum before privateer skirmishes reignite.
missions.private_fact: The captain's health is failing rapidly from space radiation and this accord is his final bid to preserve his crew's future.

player_choice.prompt: The pilot delivers the treaty charter to the summit. The director offers a fortune to convert the comet into an automated corporate utility, while the old captain pleads for guild heritage rights.

options.label: Deliver the charter reserving sixty percent of the comet for independent guild harvesters
Support the conglomerate's full automation buyout in exchange for a massive broker payoff
Force a fifty-fifty joint venture pairing automated drills with manual guild pilots

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot ratifies the guild commons treaty.
resolutions.summary: {role:harvester_guild} preserves its traditional harvesting grounds, securing cheap water across three systems while {role:corp_director} is reassigned.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot stood with the old ice captains and saved a rogue comet from corporate automation.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot backs the corporate automation buyout.
resolutions.summary: {role:water_conglomerate} automates the comet; {role:legacy_ice_captain} sells the family rig for scrap while water prices double under corporate monopoly.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot brokers a joint venture accord.
resolutions.summary: {role:water_conglomerate} and {role:harvester_guild} launch a shared harvesting consortium, balancing automation efficiency with guild labor.

resolutions.reached_by: The negotiations collapse or the pilot never gets involved.
resolutions.summary: The corporate gunboats crush the guild fleet; {role:legacy_ice_captain} dies in the comet's tail and the conglomerate seizes the entire water supply.

loose_threads.detail: Futures contracts on municipal water delivery were bought up by a conglomerate front company before the comet was discovered.
The corporate gunboat's transponder matches a decommissioned border patrol cutter sold off through a private security tender.

radio_hooks: Rogue cometary nucleus enters {system}, sparking armed standoff between ice miners and corporate security.
{role:water_conglomerate} appeals to sector court for exclusive emergency life support navigation charters.
Harvester guild vessels in {system} sound horns in protest across commercial orbital gates.

voice_direction.legacy_ice_captain: Deep, weathered, gravelly, speaking with the slow deliberate dignity of someone who has outlived an era. Refuses modern slang.
voice_direction.corp_director: Crisp, brisk, condescendingly efficient, framing total corporate takeover as an objective logistical optimization.
